mechanism_narrative: A sustained reduction in grocery-and-pharmacy mobility deficit signals normalization of local errands, which raises foot traffic to adjacent retail-and-recreation venues over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -20.7 to -6.4 over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days when GROCERY_PHARM is above -10.0.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT mobility crosses above -50 percent, it marks a threshold where commuters perceive public transport as safe, increasing trips that include discretionary retail stops within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT crosses above -50.0 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -58.9 to -44.7 over four weeks
failure_condition: After TRANSIT crosses above -50.0 for two weeks, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than or equal to the prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RESIDENTIAL mobility together with a rise in WORKPLACES mobility interact to increase after-work retail trips, producing higher RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from +18.3 to +12.9 while WORKPLACES rose from -35.6 to -25.0
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL falls and WORKPLACES rises simultaneously, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the prior 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-lockdown reopening regime, higher PARKS mobility signals that outdoor movement is permitted, and this permission effect spills over into retail visits within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from -48.7 to -23.6 in one week
regime_hint: post-lockdown reopening with stay-at-home orders lifted
failure_condition: In the post-lockdown reopening regime, a week-on-week rise in PARKS is followed by a decline in RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: December holiday shopping demand amplifies any mobility recovery, so gains in GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC during mid-December predict further retail increases over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:decision time point is 2020-12-15, within the December holiday shopping season
failure_condition: During the December holiday season, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than or equal to the prior 14-day mean despite GROCERY_PHARM improving.

mechanism_narrative: A fall in RESIDENTIAL mobility below +15 percent signals that people are leaving home more, directly increasing retail-and-recreation visits within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from +18.3 to +12.9 over four weeks
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL is below +15.0, RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is not higher than the prior 7-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES recovery and TRANSIT recovery interact positively: office return requires transit use, and both together drive weekday retail footfall over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -35.6 to -25.0 and TRANSIT rose from -58.9 to -44.7 over four weeks
failure_condition: When both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT rise over four weeks, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the prior 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp week-on-week increase in PARKS mobility above 20 points indicates outdoor leisure substitution that diverts spending from indoor retail-and-recreation venues, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from -48.7 to -23.6 in one week
failure_condition: When PARKS rises more than 20 points week-on-week, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than or equal to the prior 14-day mean.
